decisions_made.decision: Create a dedicated portfolio-brain repository in Step 1; keep project code in independent repositories.
Use immutable normalized events and evidence receipts as the cross-project integration boundary.
Observe repository deltas by exact authoritative revision and skip unchanged sources by default.
Use deterministic code before model reasoning for validation, hashes, state transitions, budgets, deduplication, arithmetic and routine aggregation.
Treat ai_business_os as the canonical donor/reference and business_os as frozen legacy.
Preserve project-native domain semantics and normalize additively through adapters.
Keep generic Portfolio Brain downstream access read-only through Step 15; bounded branch/PR creation begins only at Step 16.
Make autonomous runtime model-provider independent and never dependent on an interactive ChatGPT subscription.
Map OBSERVE/EXPERIMENT/MODIFY/ACT autonomy classes onto lower-level governance action classes rather than replacing governance.
Keep consequential external authority human-bound, including customer contact, money movement, destructive actions, child-facing consequential changes and live trading.
